measurement_contract.atomicity: Replay visits committed snapshots; concurrent mid-execution update behavior is covered by engine unit tests.
measurement_contract.cost: Actual local CPU setup plus Store.commit and Engine.run; oracle checking excluded from method timings and recorded separately.
measurement_contract.incomplete: An unknown/unsupported classification, not proof of no solution or a valid resolved answer.
measurement_contract.positive: Intentionally incomplete old-positive-dependency baseline; excluded from required-mode agreement gate.
measurement_contract.provenance: Citations include all search observations, not a minimal proof. Same selected values can still change citations and task output.
measurement_contract.public_data: Two selected subuniverses from current verified public metadata; their withdrawal events are explicitly synthetic.
measurement_contract.scope: One tracked resolver task with separately tracked relation queries; no LLM, install or runtime compatibility tests.
measurement_contract.timing_limit: Single local replay with concurrent workload not controlled; timings are diagnostic observations and cannot establish comparative speedups.
measurement_contract.truth: Independent Cartesian enumeration and witness checks; shared packaging parsing risk remains.
